observations.statement: In CrazyGames Basic Launch the SDK is optional and monetization is not available.
observations.excerpt: A game in Basic Launch allows you to go live without needing to customize your game for CrazyGames. The CrazyGames SDK is optional and monetization is not available.

observations.statement: Games selected for CrazyGames Full Launch must comply with all integration requirements including the SDK.
observations.excerpt: Once your game has been selected for Full Launch , you are required to comply to all integration requirements listed below, including the CrazyGames SDK.

observations.statement: CrazyGames technical limits: initial download ≤ 50MB, total file size ≤ 250MB (50MB without SDK), file count ≤ 1500.
observations.excerpt: Initial download size ≤ 50MB Total file size ≤ 250MB ( 50MB without SDK ) File count ≤ 1500

observations.statement: Only ads served through the CrazyGames SDK are allowed, and ad revenue share is the primary monetization.
observations.excerpt: The primary monetization mechanism we offer is through advertisement revenue share. Only ads served through our SDK are allowed

observations.statement: In-game purchases on CrazyGames are available only to selected games with a Full Implementation using Xsolla.
observations.excerpt: Selected games are eligible for In-game Purchases . A Full Implementation is required, using Xsolla as payments provider.

observations.statement: CrazyGames offers technical SDK-integration support once a developer's games reach 50k combined plays.
observations.excerpt: Once your games reach 50k plays (combined), we can offer you technical support with SDK integration.
